name: Sora Research Preview
description: OpenAI's text-to-video diffusion transformer model, generating high-fidelity video clips up to 60 seconds with physical simulation.
keyFeatures: Generates videos up to 60 seconds in duration
Maintains character and style consistency over time
Simulates basic physical interactions and object permanence
curatorNotes: Announced as a research preview on Feb 15, 2024. Operates as closed source.
